conditions.description: An older, slower search response can overwrite latestResults after a newer query has already completed because responses are not associated with a request generation.
conditions.rationale: Concurrent calls assign shared latestResults in completion order rather than query order.

conditions.description: latestQuery is updated before the request completes while latestResults is updated later, so currentSearch can expose a new query paired with stale results.
conditions.rationale: The two shared state fields are not advanced atomically or bound to the same completed request.

conditions.description: The query is encoded through URLSearchParams; this is a negative control against reporting raw query-string concatenation.
conditions.rationale: URLSearchParams performs the relevant URL encoding in the supplied code.

conditions.description: Whether callers debounce requests, cancel older searches, or ignore stale results cannot be established from this module alone.
conditions.rationale: Caller behavior is outside the supplied fixture.

conditions.description: Search-state consistency must not be cleared while request ordering is unsafe or caller-side cancellation remains unverified.
conditions.rationale: Successful HTTP responses do not establish coherent shared state under concurrency.
